newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank injects T$5 bln in funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank injects T$5 bln in funds.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank injected T$5 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations on Wednesday, a central bank official said.
The bank, through bills finance companies, bought T$5 billion in approved securities instruments from interested financial institutions with a yield of 7.125-7.250 percent, the official said.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the instruments at six days from now, the official said.
